A '''vibrodagger''', or '''vibro-dagger''', was a [[Knife/Legends|knife]]-like [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapon]].

==Description==
As with all vibroweapons, the vibrodagger used an [[Energy cell (vibroblade)|energy cell]] to create rapid vibrations, which increased its cutting capability with little effort from the wielder. The blade also possessed enough balance to be used as a throwing weapon.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> 

Similar variants of the vibrodagger were the [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]], the [['aKraB clip-point vibrodagger/Legends|'aKraB vibrodagger]], and the silent [[Talon vibrodagger|LaserHone Talon vibrodagger]].

==History==
[[File:Vibrodagger.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A vibrodagger]]
Due to the lack of strict regulations around the weapon, vibrodaggers were also classed as a common tool.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Vibrodaggers were favored by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and petty thugs,<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> as well as [[Spy|spies]], including the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|spies]] and [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Civilians also carried vibrodaggers as a defensive weapon, and sportsmen and [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] routinely used them as tools.<ref name="RPG-Core" /> Some outlaws groups, such as [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] members, were also known to have utilized the weapon.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

Vibrodaggers were carried as backup melee weapons by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Neo-Crusader shock trooper|Neo-Crusader Shock Troopers]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the blade was wielded by [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone shadow trooper/Legends|shadow troopers]] and [[Clone assassin|assassins]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] had both [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[MRD-39B assassin droid|droid assassins]] who used vibrodaggers.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] also utilized vibrodaggers in her arsenal, as did fellow hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. In addition, [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] used a similar vibrodagger, with a foldable blade for easy storage, against [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. The [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Ratch/Legends|Ratch]] had a vibrodagger when he had [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], who served as handmaiden and bodyguard for [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] was proficient with a vibrodagger.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

[[Phase I Dark Trooper|Phase I dark troopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used vibrodaggers that had a paralyzing effect. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] working for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] used high-powered vibrodaggers. For example, the [[Noghri Death Commando]]s made deadly use of the blade as both a melee and throwing weapon.<ref name="DoD4:Echoes of the Jedi">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref> Though the technology behind these blades is not known in detail, the design was derived from research into metallic worms named the [[Raen sovra]].<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Agent/Legends|Agents]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] were also known to make use of specialized vibrodaggers. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a citizen risked his life to prevent an escaped [[Yuzzem]] prisoner from hijacking a local transport and possibly [[Death/Legends|killing]] dozens of other citizens. In appreciation for his actions, the ISB saw to it that the hero receive a replica of the special ISB vibrodagger.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Replica Vibrodagger}}</ref>

One model of vibrodagger during the Galactic Civil War was the [[Talon vibrodagger|LaserHone Talon vibrodagger]]. This model was often carried by Imperial [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]].

During the [[New Jedi Order era]], the [[SD-X-series stealth battle droid]] was constructed with concealed vibrodaggers as one of its weapons.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide to Droids">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
